mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(u.user_name, '미배정') AS label, t.team_name AS sub_label, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN i.submit_status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'CONFIRMED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "value" FROM round_item i LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = i.assignee_id LEFT JOIN team t ON t.team_code = i.team_code WHERE i.round_id = #{roundId} AND i.excluded_yn = 'N' AND i.no_reply_yn = 'N' GROUP BY u.user_name, t.team_name ORDER BY CASE WHEN u.user_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, t.team_name, u.user_name
SELECT i.inspection_result AS "key", COUNT(*) AS "value" FROM round_item i WHERE i.round_id = #{roundId} AND i.excluded_yn = 'N' GROUP BY i.inspection_result
SELECT m.action_result AS "key", m.closed_yn AS label, COUNT(*) AS "value" FROM improvement m GROUP BY m.action_result, m.closed_yn
